spanish: Y puso el candelabro en tienda de reunión, frente a la mesa, sobre el muslo del tabernáculo, hacia el sur.
grammarChanges: 'menorá' -> 'el candelabro' (h02040024003, H4501, definite common noun): translated instead of transliterated, per cited fail.
Removed the definite article before 'tienda de reunión' because the construct noun and the absolute noun carry no definite article in the source (h02040024004, h02040024005), per cited warn.
'mishkán' -> 'tabernáculo' (h02040024010, H4908, definite common noun): translated instead of transliterated, per cited fail.
'Negbah' -> 'hacia el sur' (h02040024011, H5045, common noun with directional suffix): translated instead of transliterated so the southward force is in Spanish, per cited fail.
